d7Note: D7 eligibility implemented in assemble_universe.py. Policy exclusion beyond the sim's equip rules -- weapon type(s) 5, 7 and one-handed weapons: Retribution is a two-handed spec: Seal of Command and the ret talent tree are built around a single slow two-hander, and a paladin wielding a one-hander with a shield is playing protection or holy. This repo builds no holy or protection universe, so a shield like Bulwark of Azzinoth (id 32375) has no list it legitimately belongs to. Shields and one-handers are excluded because they are not low-ranked ret candidates but correct items for a different spec, and their presence in a retribution list reads as a build recommendation the tool is not making.
